A collection of my hats creations.This way, you don't have to download individual packs.But it maybe will update slowly.

[color=#ff0000][b]This is a FS module, you need to go to Pierre to buy the hand mirror and get it through the hand mirror.If you have any questions about the FS module, please go to the fashion sense module page for reference.[/b][/color][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Need[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]SMAPI, Fashion sense[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]3.Put the folder in "Mods".[/size]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Update Log[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]1.0.1[/size]
1. Add dyeable features to four hats.
[size=3]2. [/size]Fix some coordinate errors in hats.[b]

[color=#ff7700][size=3]There may be an issue of abnormal color display after dyeing. You can try rotating the character preview direction on the hand mirror interface until the dyeing of the character's hat matches the display in FS.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff]Important[/color][/b]
[size=3]1.This pack fits into another mod of mine. [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]click here[/url]
[size=3]2.You could choose to delete them as you like.(Open the "Stardew Valley\Mods\[FS]Kyuya's hats\Hats",and delete which you dislike.)[/size]
[size=3]3. You can edit this mod for your own use. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.
4. Please do not spend money on modules published by non authors for any reason.[/size]

[size=3]Thank you for using my module,have fun < 3~[/size]
